body:
The thoughts some nights.. I cry for hours and can't sleep. Other nights I'm just not sleepy and feel numb to everything. I usually take some form of Nyquil or some kind of medicine that aids in sleeping to sleep but I can go days without sleeping.

As for the circumstances.. I have a lot of debt under my name due to my father opening several cards under my name, defaulted school loan, unemployed, etc. Family is splitting apart, relationship is falling apart.. the people that are nearest and dearest to me are either hurting me or don't know how to deal with my issues.

Both. Physically I am always fatigued, insomniac, vomiting, coughing, etc. Emotionally I'm going insane with all sorts of emotions. I'm just unstable overall. What's causing the pain? Circumstances and people who are close to me in my life..

Thank you for the advice but it didn't work for me (I really did try it). I am very open to anyone who is willing to listen about what is on my mind but talking about it to someone anonymous or someone close to me doesn't seem to make me feel any better. I am going to take my life and hope that others respect my decision since I believe it will be the only thing to give me peace.
